scope: Independent static review of exact files before launch; no compiler, test process, checker, network or new serialized export invoked. Root still must satisfy committed launch gate.

checks.typing_lifetimes: Source-plausible. Config::to_export_file is generic in output lifetime; owned ExportFile contains all persistent names and stored operands. Context-local expression/name lifetimes do not escape closures. Ptr types are constrained by Name::Str and Expr::NatLit; CowStr::Borrowed suffixes are static. Compilation remains unverified.
checks.name_hashing: name() interns suffix strings in owned export DAG and hashes Name::Str with STR_HASH, prefix and exact string pointer, matching TcCtx::str. Nat prefix and six canonical suffixes are interned. Refreshed mk_name_cache entries are asserted equal to the six name pointers in CASES order.
checks.nonvacuous_setup: fixture loads Empty template only to reuse config, then enables nat_extension before parsing a fresh export and before with_tc builds temporary DAG. Both export and temporary bignum stores therefore exist for positive literal construction. Both inputs use expect and match NatLit; results require Some and NatLit with exact payload.
checks.dispatcher_reach: Closed mk_const/mk_app expressions call crate-internal try_reduce_nat directly; its six name comparisons map to do_nat_bin. NatLit arguments make whnf return immediately, so EnvLimit::Empty is adequate without declaring Nat constants. This does not demonstrate a checked declaration/public import route.
checks.positive_values: All six CASES results are correct. For each individual input pair, expected result differs from the other five newly added native operations, even though gcd and xor rows both equal 6 for different inputs.
checks.disabled_control: stored_literal creates properly hashed Expr::NatLit and bignums in owned export DAG with ExportFile marker. Enabled phase first checks land(10,12)=8. Config then disabled between context borrows; original persistent operand pointers and their payloads are rechecked. try_reduce_nat returns None at config guard before reading temp bignum storage. Application expressions are rebuilt in each context; operand identity is retained, application pointer identity is not claimed.
checks.wiring: src/tests.rs adds mod nat_dispatch under lib.rs cfg(test) mod tests. Two unignored #[test] functions are wired; production source untouched.
checks.scope_and_duplication: Known Nat.land is preventive reuse/control. Five other operations extend focused Cargo coverage. No current defect, universal absence, new scientific mismatch, public export reachability, or six-novel-discoveries claim.

limitations: Static review is not proof of compilation or executed reach; focused/full suite still required.
Hash/intern construction intentionally uses crate-internal DAG APIs and does not add serialized data.
Disabled retained-DAG state is a unit fixture for internal configuration guard, not a normal disabled importer outcome.
